title: mouse without borders not work
author: Septemberlemon
summary: After applying a Settings workaround, Mouse Without Borders cannot create a new security key or show paired devices; the reporter later indicates that disabling "CET" for PowerToys.MouseWithoutBorders.exe changes the outcome.

judgment.rationale: The follow-up introduces a potentially important mitigation-related clue, but neither it nor the screenshot identifies the exact CET setting, whether it resolves both symptoms, or the failing process behavior. The earlier diagnostic archive could not be analyzed because of an oversized entry, so the report still cannot distinguish a mitigation conflict from key generation, discovery, service, or configuration failure.
evidence: The issue specifies PowerToysUserSetup-0.101.2432.0-x64 from GitHub and is labeled Product-Mouse Without Borders.
The reporter says clicking New Key does nothing and no devices appear in the list after the Settings workaround from issue #50335.
The attached PowerToys report archive was rejected because it contains an oversized entry.

The reporter's two later comments state that closing CET for PowerToys.MouseWithoutBorders.exe took substantial time and include a screenshot, but do not give the exact setting or a reproducible before-and-after result.
The issue has no assignee, linked fix, or confirmed duplicate resolution.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact CET configuration and its effect on the two symptoms, plus a newly generated diagnostic archive captured immediately after reproducing with the normal configuration.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix attempt exists. A compatibility failure involving the reported executable's mitigation configuration is plausible, but diagnostic and configuration evidence is required before a PowerToys implementation change can be scoped.

comment.body: Thanks for the follow-up about closing CET for PowerToys.MouseWithoutBorders.exe. Please identify the exact CET or exploit-protection setting you changed, where you changed it, its before-and-after values, and whether restoring the normal setting brings back both the unresponsive New Key control and the empty device list. Then, with the normal setting restored, reproduce the failure and add a comment containing /bugreport immediately afterward so a fresh diagnostic ZIP can be captured. This will show whether the CET change is the cause and which Mouse Without Borders operation is failing.
